edits.new: An ancestor may establish a category restriction left implicit by the selected subject when the original branch and post support that interpretation. Preserve the selected level of abstraction: descendants and details of a particular example do not exhaust the category or automatically become defining conditions.
edits.old: Preserve the full scope of that subject in the chosen sense. Distinguish resolving a different sense from restricting the same category to the post's particular kind, use, purpose, state or circumstance. An example does not make those details category-wide conditions.

edits.new: Do not apply every ancestor restriction automatically or discard any named alternative or required part to make a relationship fit.
edits.old: A relationship cannot add a restriction missing from the selected subject or justify discarding part of it to make it fit.
